message: 否念
Day one of midterms is over. Instead of heading straight home from school, I made my way down to the wharf.
I was prepared for it, sure, but my lack of studying really took a toll on my spirit. I think I'll hang out at Tsukinoo Park for a while to clear my head.

name: Azel
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, you came here too? Out for a walk?」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Azel
message: 「I sensed a mysterious flow of energy, which led me to this place.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why is that? Why does listening to the roar of the tide bring such peace to my mind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you ask me why... All I can say is that's just how it is.」

name: Azel
message: 「That makes no sense.」

name: Azel
message: 「I can see the ocean from the academy's high ground and along the road to school, yet it never puts me in this mild a mood.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hmm, maybe it's because of the sound of the waves?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right--I think there's a theory that before we're born, the sounds we hear inside our mother's womb are just like gentle ripples.」

name: Azel
message: 「So this is the sound of a world being born. Understood. In that case, I shall listen a while longer.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Okay, Amyrina, I'm going to read the book now. Please listen closely.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-I still can't read the letters here, so I'm happy you're telling me the story, but... um...」
Lolotte and Emilina were sitting on a bench nearby.
With an old, leather-bound book open between them, the two were peering into it side by side, completely unaware of Azel and me.

name: Amyrina
message: 「A―Are you sure about this? You have more exams tomorrow, don't you? Rather than a picture book, shouldn't you be studying―」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-Things like that don't matter at all.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Title: 'Peter Pan' ♪ Peter Pan was--」
Overcome with nostalgia, I listen in on Lolotte's reading.
My parents told it to me over and over when I was little―h―huh?! What was Peter Pan even about again?
Flying through the sky with the children, fighting pirates... I can remember the iconic scenes, but I've completely forgotten the overall plot.
I wonder which one Azel is listening more closely to: the sound of the waves, or the fairy tale?
